newsitem.title: UK: UK CBI worried if sterling strength persists.
newsitem.headline: UK CBI worried if sterling strength persists.

text.p: Adair Turner, director-general of the Confederation of British Industry (CBI), said on Thursday he would be worried if sterling's gains in recent day were to persist.
"It would be concerning if the move in the pound over the last day or so turns into another major upward trend," he told reporters.
"That is why, on balance, we would tend towards leaving interest rates as they are now."
Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke left official interest rates unchanged at 6.0 percent at his monthly monetary meeting with Bank of England Governor Eddie George on Wednesday.
